description:
Poll a device login to token issuance (UC-091, RFC 8628). Anonymous. While
the human has not signed in yet it answers `{"status": "pending",
"retry_after": <seconds>}`: wait `retry_after` seconds and call again with the
same `challenge_id`. On approval it returns Keycloak's token set
(`access_token`, `refresh_token`, `expires_in`, ...) exactly once; pass the
`access_token` as `authorization` ('Bearer <token>') to every other tool.
name: verify_device_login
title: Verify Device Login
